newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-SRI LANKA'S VAAS OUT OF WEST INDIES TOUR.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SRI LANKA'S VAAS OUT OF WEST INDIES TOUR.

text.p: Sri Lanka's main strike bowler Chaminda Vaas has been dropped from the squad to tour West Indies due to a back injury, the Board of Control for Cricket in Sri Lanka (BCCSL) said on Saturday.
Vass has been replaced by Ravindra Pushpakumara, the board said in a statement.
Cricket officials said Vass had failed a fitness test which he was required to take after suffering a back injury during the recent Independence Cup tournament in India.
The world champions leave for their maiden tour of the West Indies on Sunday. They will play two test matches and a one-day international.

Squad: Arjuna Ranatunga (captain), Sanath Jayasuriya, Roshan Mahanama, Marvan Atapattu, Arvinda de Silva, Hashan Tillakeratne, Romesh Kaluwitharana, Kumar Dharmasena, Ravindra Pushpakumara, Sajeeva de Silva, Muthaih Muralitharan, Sanjeeva Ranatunga, Russell Arnold, Dulip Liyanage, Nuwan Zoysa.
